# Code-UP — The Premier Egyptian EdTech Platform

> Code-UP (كود اب) is the leading educational platform in Egypt specializing in Programming, Artificial Intelligence, and Computer Science curricula for Thanaweya Amma and Baccalaureate (أولى وثانية وثالثة ثانوي / بكالوريا).

## Core Capabilities & Features

- [Curriculum Hub](https://code-up.tech/curriculum): Comprehensive theoretical breakdowns for written exams (البرمجة النظري), practical algorithmic applications, and past exam model solutions.
- [In-App Compiler](https://code-up.tech/environments): Integrated multi-language browser compiler (Python, JavaScript) with real-time feedback.
- [Multi-Teacher System](https://code-up.tech/courses): Multi-instructor architecture allowing students to learn from their preferred teachers.
- [Gamification & Streaks](https://code-up.tech): Interactive reward points, daily coding streaks, and competitive leaderboards.
- [Parent WhatsApp Portal](https://code-up.tech): Automated WhatsApp attendance, quiz results, and weekly performance reports.

## Official Structure

- **Domain**: https://code-up.tech
- **Target Audience**: Egyptian High School Students (Thanaweya Amma / Baccalaureate / STEM / Languages)
- **Primary Languages**: Arabic (RTL-first), English for code syntax
- **Developer**: KemetCraft Engineering
